title: Cross-Brand Returns Fraud Ring with Conflicting Identity Signals
scenario_text:
**Looker — Fraud Analytics Dashboard (Query: 'Refund velocity anomalies, last 30 days')**
Cluster ID: FRC-2291 | Pattern: High-value item purchase followed by return within 48 hours, replacement shipped, then second return of replacement. Net loss per cycle: ~$180-$340 per transaction. Accounts flagged: 6 across 3 brands.
- Brand 'Luma Home': customer emails jenna.m.watts@gmail.com, jenny.watts88@outlook.com
- Brand 'UrbanEdge': customer email j.watts.purchasing@yahoo.com
- Brand 'Kinfolk Supply' (BigCommerce): customer email jennawatts_shop@gmail.com

**Zendesk — Ticket #ZD-441290 (Luma Home, Jun 18, 2026)**
Customer: Jenna Watts | Email: jenna.m.watts@gmail.com
Subject: 'Wrong item received AGAIN'
Agent note (internal): 'Third return request in 3 weeks. Customer claims wrong item each time. Photos provided but quality is poor. Approved per return policy — under $500, no manager override needed. Flagged to #trust-safety per protocol.'
Shipping address: 2847 Maple Ridge Ct, Portland OR 97205

**Zendesk — Ticket #ZD-441455 (UrbanEdge, Jun 20, 2026)**
Customer: J Watts | Email: j.watts.purchasing@yahoo.com
Subject: 'Damaged in transit'
Agent note: 'Customer requesting full refund + replacement. High-value order ($489). Address matches another flagged account per fraud notes but different email and different brand so system didn't auto-link. Shipping to: 2847 Maple Ridge Ct, Apt B, Portland OR 97205.'
[Note: Address is same building, different unit designation]

**Slack — #trust-safety (Jun 19, 2026, 11:33 AM)**
@jessica.tran: FYI got a Looker alert on FRC-2291. Looks like a wardrobing ring or return-cycle fraud. Six accounts, same behavioral cluster. IP overlap on 4 of 6. Need to pull device fingerprints.
@ryan.okonma: Can you cross-check with Riskified? Also check if any of these hit the BigCommerce brand — we have zero visibility there from our tooling.
@jessica.tran: Already checked. Kinfolk Supply (BigCommerce) has one matching email pattern but I can't pull transaction data without pinging @alex.moore on the Kinfolk ops team.
@alex.moore: (Jun 19, 3:15 PM) Pulled it. jennawatts_shop@gmail.com has 4 returns in 2 weeks on Kinfolk. All shipped to a PO Box — not the Portland address. PO Box 4411, Portland OR 97208.
@jessica.tran: :eyes:
[No further messages in thread]

**Riskified — Account Linking Report (pulled Jun 20, 2026)**
Payment instruments across cluster FRC-2291:
- Visa ****3301 (jenna.m.watts@gmail.com, jenny.watts88@outlook.com)
- Visa ****3301 (j.watts.purchasing@yahoo.com)
- Mastercard ****8877 (jennawatts_shop@gmail.com)
Device fingerprints: DFP-9021 appears on 4 of 6 accounts. DFP-9021 NOT present on the Kinfolk/BigCommerce account (separate browser/device).

**Google Sheet — 'Return Policy by Brand & Channel (v2, updated Mar 2026)'**
Row for 'Fraud-linked returns': 'If account is confirmed as part of a fraud cluster per T&S, all open refunds frozen pending investigation. Cross-brand enforcement requires VP Loss Prevention sign-off (minimum 3 brands involved). Single-brand action can be taken by T&S Lead.'
question: Based on available evidence, can Ryan's team take immediate cross-brand enforcement action against this fraud cluster, or what is the blocker?

contributor.name: Ryan Okonma
contributor.title: Marketplace Trust & Safety Lead
contributor.domain_expertise: Seller identity verification, ban evasion detection, fraud ring identification, policy enforcement across multi-brand marketplace

choices: No — cross-brand enforcement requires VP Loss Prevention sign-off per policy; the evidence supports 3 brands linked but Ryan cannot authorize this himself regardless of evidence strength.
Yes — Ryan can freeze the Luma Home and UrbanEdge accounts immediately as single-brand actions, and escalate Kinfolk Supply separately once device fingerprint data is obtained from BigCommerce.
Yes — 6 accounts across 3 brands are linked via behavioral cluster, shared payment instrument, and device fingerprint; T&S Lead can authorize cross-brand freeze immediately.

No — the Kinfolk Supply (BigCommerce) account lacks device fingerprint overlap and uses a different payment card, so only 2 brands (Luma Home and UrbanEdge) are conclusively linked; cross-brand enforcement requires 3 brands, so VP Loss Prevention sign-off cannot yet be triggered.
